description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1603/35 of 28.05.2009 which specifies the Faculties and the Departments of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura by substituting the entry '9 Department of English and Linguistics'.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. The Minister is exercising powers vested by this Act to amend the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Sri Jayawardenepura. While a minister is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about modifying the legal framework governing university structures through statutory authority. The content focuses on regulatory amendment rather than government organizational structure or personnel matters.
